title: Los 1
description: Im Folgenden soll die Bereitstellung des IuK-Netzes zum Betrieb der hessischen SAPOS®-Referenzstationen sowie Betrieb der SAPOS®-Anwendungen in einer Cloud erbracht werden. Zur Vermeidung von Ausfällen der SAPOS®- Dienste ist zwingend ein bis zu 6-monatiger Parallelbetrieb mit dem derzeitigen Auftragnehmer notwendig. Um diesen sicherzustellen wird der Bestandsvertrag um den entsprechenden Zeitraum verlängert werden. Zum Betrieb des SAPOS® - IuK-Netzes werden vom Auftragnehmer alle notwendigen Endgeräte zur Verfügung gestellt und betriebsfertig konfiguriert. Bei allen Fragen zur angebotenen Cloud und dessen Support ist die offene Zusammenarbeit zwischen den Auftragnehmern der Lose 1 und 2 Voraussetzung. Zu erbringende Leistungen: a) Ausfallsichere Bereitstellung und Betrieb von mindestens 7 virtuellen Servern in einer Cloud des Auftragnehmers Aktuell bestehen folgende Konfigurationen: 4 Server mit 4vCPUs, 16 GB, Windows STD 2019 1 Server mit 4vCPUs, 8 GB, Windows STD 2019 1 Server mit 2vCPUs, 4 GB, Windows STD 2019 1 Server mit 1vCPU, 1 GB, Standard Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 uefi latest b) Möglichkeit maximal zwei weitere Server in Betrieb zu nehmen. title: CRYOGENIC OPERATIONS IN NEAR VACUUM: FLASH-DISINTEGRATION RELATED TO STORAGE AND REUSABILITY - EXPRO+
description: Objective: To investigate flash transformations during depressurization for superheated cryogenic liquids and to model and validateflash atomization, vaporization, condensation and icing processes.Description: Flash-boiling is an extremely complex physical phenomenon and includes nucleate boiling, bubble growth, droplets formation, evaporation and (possibly) solidification in a vapor-dropletmedium. In particular operating engine re-ignition, venting or attitude control devices results into hard ignition, erroneous forceand torque estimation and into 'ice' deposition on walls with potential damaging impact when breaking off. In order to model this complex flash-boiling process and solidification process, an integrated experimental and theoretical study shall combine synergicallydifferent disciplines and skills. An integrated comparative approach, based on detailed experiments, molecular dynamic simulations,modern molecular kinetic theory for modelling nucleation, bubble growth and evaporation processes, is a substantial leap forward with respect to the current modelling approaches that still heavily rely on empirical correlations or quasi-equilibrium assumptions. Experimentally, non-intrusive velocity and droplet size measurements in flash-boiling sprays, separation of ice particle areas from liquid droplet areas and visualization of the internal injector/orifice flow are envisaged, paired by systematic and controlled experiments on dropwise condensation/evaporation. These sets of experiments will provide then the basis for the development and validation of a comprehensive physical model, capable of describing and predicting the behaviour of cryogenic flashing jets. Theoretically, accurate models will be proposed to describe the evolution of the bubble size distributions within the nozzle flow (or liquid jets),the fragmentation process and the process of superheated dropwise evaporation. For the theoretical analysis, different approaches will be used: direct and approximated solutions of the Boltzmann equations, molecular dynamic simulations and the kinetic theory of homogeneous nucleation. The final goal is to include kinetic effects in the formulation of macroscopic models to improve the accuracyofthe predictions for large departure from equilibrium (i.e., at highly superheated conditions). This activity encompasses the following tasks: - Cryogenic spray experiments - Superheated droplet evaporation experiments and modelling - Modelling of the boiling process and fragmentation.http://www.esa.int/About_Us/Business_with_ESA/Small_and_Medium_Sized_Enterprises/Opportunities_for_SMEs/Procurement_policy_on_fair_access_for_SMEs_-_the_C1-C4_Clauses
